title: RealityBreak
description: RealityBreak is a chaotic and fun plugin for Minecraft 1.16.5 servers (Spigot, Paper, Purpur) that accidentally distorts reality in the game world.
body:
**RealityBreak is a unique plugin for Minecraft 1.16.5 servers (Spigot, Paper, Purpur), which introduces an element of chaos and fun into the gameplay, making each game session unpredictable and memorable!**

**What does RealityBreak add?**

Random reality distortions: The plugin automatically selects and applies one of the many crazy effects to the world or players once every set time interval (for example, every 5 minutes).
Funny and unexpected events: No one knows what will happen next, which makes the game exciting and full of surprises.
Flexible customization: All effects, their frequency and parameters are easily configured via the convenient config.yml file. Russian and English languages are supported.

**Main functions**

Gravity Deactivation: All players and entities begin to float upward, as if in zero gravity.
Swapping blocks: Under the players' feet, the ground can suddenly turn into lava, cake, water, or even TNT.
Inversion of colors: The world becomes like a negative, which creates a surreal atmosphere.
Substitution of sounds: Creepers hiss like sheep, and pigs growl like ghasts — laughter and surprise are guaranteed!
Time jumps: Day and night change every few seconds, confusing even experienced players.
Drunk mode: The effect of nausea appears in the players, the controls become inadequate.
Quantum Jumper: When jumping, the player teleports to a random location nearby.
The madness of the chat: All player messages are encrypted and become unreadable to others.

**Why should I download RealityBreak?**

Ideal for events, mini-games, and fun servers: The plugin is perfect for parties, streams, contests, and just to surprise your friends.
Fully customizable: You decide for yourself which effects will be active, how often they will occur, and how long they will last.
Easy integration: Just copy the jar file to the plugins folder and configure it for yourself.
Compatibility: Works on Spigot, Paper, Purpur 1.16.5 and Java 8+.
